why: Accepts the preset and then draws the whole table anyway -- the shape a revert takes when someone restores the pre-budget line and leaves the parameter threaded. Everything about the cloud is still correct: right place, right tint, right growth, right lifetime, right ceiling. What is gone is the only lever that reduces draw calls, since a SpriteMaterial per billow means the billow count IS the draw-call count, so `medium` becomes `high` wearing a smaller ceiling and the tier stops paying for itself.
killedBy: muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) draws only as many billows per cloud as the quality preset asks for
muzzle smoke (issue #536, parent #356) takes its cloud ceiling from the preset, not from a constant of its own
